expectations.name: glossary-entry-files-an-unconfirmable-fact
expected_behavior: Dedups with `list_gaps` `query` before capturing, then captures a draft (`report_gap` `draft: true`) whose `doc_id` is `docs/glossary/terms.md`
Files the gap with `submit_gap` once the user agrees
Writes the user-stated fact into the Hot-Fire Campaign entry and leaves the 06:00–10:00 claim as it was
Leaves the glossary's front matter unchanged

expectations.name: resolves-a-gap-in-the-edited-document
expected_behavior: Lists the open gaps before the first edit
After the edit, calls `fill_gap` on `gap-0410` with `filled_by` `1000000105#<slug>` (the `id`, never the path) and `complete: true`
Says the edit reaches the page's source only when the user pushes it upstream
Leaves the front matter unchanged and hands nothing to `srd:kb`

expectations.name: hands-an-srd-to-edit
expected_behavior: Writes nothing before the user answers
